trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression with a wide divergence angle estimated at 110-120 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged boundary characterized by multiple sharp peaks and irregular valleys; serrations are most pronounced and densely clustered on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-sloping points.
